Subject: Feedback regarding my recent stay - Exceptional Service

Dear [Hotel Manager's Name],

I hope this email finds you well.

I am writing to express my sincere appreciation for the exceptional service I experienced during my recent stay at your hotel. From the moment I arrived until my departure, the level of hospitality and attention to detail was truly outstanding.

I would like to specifically commend [Employee Name 1] and [Employee Name 2] for making my stay so memorable. [Employee Name 1] was incredibly helpful and attentive, while [Employee Name 2] went above and beyond to ensure my comfort. Their professionalism and warm demeanor truly set your establishment apart.

Because of this wonderful experience, I will definitely be recommending your hotel to my peers and colleagues. It is rare to find such consistent excellence in customer service, and I am grateful for the positive impression your team has left on me.

Thank you again for a fantastic stay. I look forward to returning in the future.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Phone Number]
